$comment: Demo custom-bot catalog for GhostGrid. The frontend reads this to populate the city with varied buildings before the Bot Runner (/api/v1/bots, owned by Codex) is wired. Every script here is self-contained, stdlib-only, paper/simulation-first, and emits NDJSON events on stdout. 'inspiredBy' points at the real open-source project each demo mimics in spirit — no third-party code is bundled or executed.

bots.name: Paper Trading Bot
bots.description: Simulated SMA-crossover strategy over a synthetic random-walk price. Tracks a paper portfolio and emits buy/sell signals and PnL. No real orders, no exchange keys.

bots.name: Market Signal Bot
bots.description: Generates RSI / momentum signals on a simulated order book. Flashes volatility as signal intensity — good for driving neon ticker animations.

bots.name: Security Log Watchtower
bots.description: Tails a log file and flags suspicious lines (failed logins, sudo, port scans) with severity. Drives red-alert visuals in the Security District.

bots.name: Network Healthcheck Bot
bots.description: Pings a list of URLs, records latency and up/down status. Building goes offline-red when a target fails.

bots.name: RSS Feed Watcher
bots.description: Polls an RSS/Atom feed, de-dupes by item id (watermark), emits new items. Feeds the Memory District's knowledge intake.

bots.name: Repo Commit Watcher
bots.description: Watches a public GitHub repo for new commits via the public API (no token needed for low rate). Emits a pulse per new commit — drives Code District activity lights.
